name: Decant
description: Decant indexes local coding-agent session logs into a searchable SQLite archive with a CLI and local web UI for transcript search and usage analytics.
description_good_justification: The README describes how Decant indexes coding-agent sessions and exposes search and usage insights. https://github.com/dosu-ai/decant/blob/main/README.md
interact_justification: The README provides installation commands and links to contribution and bug-report instructions. https://github.com/dosu-ai/decant/blob/main/README.md
contribution_justification: Contributors submit issues and pull requests; the guide explains scope agreement, review, and squash merging. https://github.com/dosu-ai/decant/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md
contribution_requirements_justification: The guide requires focused changes, synthetic fixtures, tests, formatting, and signed commits. https://github.com/dosu-ai/decant/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md
floss_license_justification: The root LICENSE contains the Apache License 2.0, an OSI-approved FLOSS license. https://github.com/dosu-ai/decant/blob/main/LICENSE
floss_license_osi_justification: The root LICENSE contains the Apache License 2.0, an OSI-approved FLOSS license. https://github.com/dosu-ai/decant/blob/main/LICENSE
license_location_justification: The root LICENSE contains the Apache License 2.0, an OSI-approved FLOSS license. https://github.com/dosu-ai/decant/blob/main/LICENSE
documentation_basics_justification: The README covers installation, startup, CLI examples, and secure local use, including archive privacy and Docker binding. https://github.com/dosu-ai/decant/blob/main/README.md
documentation_interface_justification: The OpenAPI contract defines local API inputs and outputs; the README documents CLI commands and points users to generated --help reference output. https://github.com/dosu-ai/decant/blob/main/docs/api/openapi.yaml
sites_https_justification: The repository, project documentation, npm package, and GitHub Release downloads support HTTPS. https://github.com/dosu-ai/decant/
discussion_justification: GitHub issues, pull requests, and Discussions provide searchable, URL-addressable discussions in a browser. https://github.com/dosu-ai/decant/discussions
english_justification: Documentation and issue-report instructions are in English, and the project accepts English contributions. https://github.com/dosu-ai/decant/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md
maintained_justification: Recent releases and merged fixes demonstrate active maintenance. https://github.com/dosu-ai/decant/releases
repo_public_justification: The Git source repository is publicly readable. https://github.com/dosu-ai/decant/
repo_track_justification: Git history records changes, authors, and commit dates. https://github.com/dosu-ai/decant/commits/main/
repo_interim_justification: The main branch and pull requests expose intermediate development changes between tagged releases. https://github.com/dosu-ai/decant/pulls
repo_distributed_justification: The documented git clone workflow uses distributed Git version control. https://github.com/dosu-ai/decant/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md
version_unique_justification: Releases use unique vMAJOR.MINOR.PATCH version tags, including v0.12.1. https://github.com/dosu-ai/decant/releases
version_semver_justification: Releases use unique vMAJOR.MINOR.PATCH version tags, including v0.12.1. https://github.com/dosu-ai/decant/releases
version_tags_justification: Releases use unique vMAJOR.MINOR.PATCH version tags, including v0.12.1. https://github.com/dosu-ai/decant/releases
release_notes_justification: GitHub Releases summarize changes with pull-request links and a full comparison link. https://github.com/dosu-ai/decant/releases
release_notes_vulns_justification: No release has yet fixed a publicly known run-time vulnerability with a CVE, so there is nothing to list. https://github.com/dosu-ai/decant/security/advisories
report_process_justification: Users report bugs through GitHub issue templates with expected and actual results and a synthetic reproduction. https://github.com/dosu-ai/decant/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md
report_tracker_justification: GitHub Issues tracks individual bug reports and enhancement requests. https://github.com/dosu-ai/decant/issues
report_responses_justification: Every bug report from outside contributors in the last 12 months was acknowledged. For example, https://github.com/dosu-ai/decant/issues/142 received a same-day reply and was triaged with labels.
enhancement_responses_justification: Every enhancement request from outside contributors in the last 12 months got a response. Issues #130, #132, and #134 were implemented and closed, and #189 was triaged: https://github.com/dosu-ai/decant/issues?q=is%3Aissue
report_archive_justification: GitHub preserves searchable issues and their responses, including closed reports. https://github.com/dosu-ai/decant/issues?q=is%3Aissue
vulnerability_report_process_justificati: The security policy documents private reporting, required reproduction details, and supported versions. https://github.com/dosu-ai/decant/blob/main/SECURITY.md
vulnerability_report_private_justificati: SECURITY.md directs reporters to GitHub private vulnerability reporting, which is enabled for the repository. https://github.com/dosu-ai/decant/blob/main/SECURITY.md
vulnerability_report_response_justificat: No vulnerability reports were received in the last 6 months. Reports go through GitHub private vulnerability reporting, as described in https://github.com/dosu-ai/decant/blob/main/SECURITY.md
build_justification: The distribution guide documents building native binaries and npm packages from source. https://github.com/dosu-ai/decant/blob/main/docs/distribution.md
build_common_tools_justification: The documented build and development workflow uses Bun, TypeScript, and standard shell commands. https://github.com/dosu-ai/decant/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md
build_floss_tools_justification: Source builds use FLOSS tooling, including Bun and TypeScript, without requiring proprietary build tools. https://github.com/dosu-ai/decant/blob/main/package.json
test_justification: Bun runs an automated suite with parser, storage, CLI, API, and UI tests, including generated parser inputs. https://github.com/dosu-ai/decant/blob/main/test/parser-properties.test.ts
test_invocation_justification: The validation instructions document bun test as the test-suite command. https://github.com/dosu-ai/decant/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md
test_most_justification: bun test --coverage reports about 86% line and function coverage across the 145 test files in https://github.com/dosu-ai/decant/tree/main/test
test_continuous_integration_justificatio: CI runs bun test on pull requests and pushes to main. https://github.com/dosu-ai/decant/blob/main/.github/workflows/ci.yml
test_policy_justification: The definition of done requires focused tests for new behavior and prohibits weakening or deleting tests to pass. https://github.com/dosu-ai/decant/blob/main/AGENTS.md
tests_are_added_justification: The suite includes tests for supported sources and newer behavior, including OpenCode, Copilot, and update verification. https://github.com/dosu-ai/decant/blob/main/test/
tests_documented_added_justification: The contribution guide requires tests alongside behavior changes and names the validation commands. https://github.com/dosu-ai/decant/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md
warnings_justification: CI runs Biome lint checks and the TypeScript type checker. https://github.com/dosu-ai/decant/blob/main/.github/workflows/ci.yml
warnings_fixed_justification: Biome currently reports 128 warnings, and CI does not fail on warnings; maintainer confirmation is needed that the remaining warnings are accepted or scheduled for correction. https://github.com/dosu-ai/decant/blob/main/biome.json
warnings_strict_justification: TypeScript enables strict mode, unchecked indexed access checks, explicit overrides, and switch fallthrough checks. https://github.com/dosu-ai/decant/blob/main/tsconfig.json
know_secure_design_justification: The threat model and access controls document security design, but a primary developer must attest to knowledge of every design principle required by this criterion. https://github.com/dosu-ai/decant/blob/main/SECURITY.md
know_common_errors_justification: The security policy identifies parser, filesystem, and network risks, but a primary developer must confirm knowledge of common vulnerability classes and their mitigations. https://github.com/dosu-ai/decant/blob/main/SECURITY.md
crypto_published_justification: Update checks and default release downloads use HTTPS, and release checksum verification uses the published SHA-256 algorithm through node:crypto. https://github.com/dosu-ai/decant/blob/main/src/update.ts
crypto_call_justification: The updater calls node:crypto for SHA-256 and the runtime fetch implementation for HTTPS instead of implementing cryptographic primitives. https://github.com/dosu-ai/decant/blob/main/src/update.ts
crypto_floss_justification: The Bun runtime and its node:crypto-compatible API provide the HTTPS and SHA-256 operations using FLOSS implementations. https://github.com/dosu-ai/decant/blob/main/package.json
crypto_keylength_justification: Decant generates no keys. It verifies SHA-256 checksums and Sigstore attestations, and HTTPS uses the Bun runtime TLS defaults.
crypto_working_justification: The updater uses SHA-256 and default HTTPS transport rather than a broken application-defined cryptographic algorithm. https://github.com/dosu-ai/decant/blob/main/src/update.ts
crypto_weaknesses_justification: The default update mechanism uses HTTPS and SHA-256; the application does not select SHA-1 or another known-weak algorithm for update verification. https://github.com/dosu-ai/decant/blob/main/src/update.ts
crypto_pfs_justification: Decant implements no key agreement protocol. HTTPS connections use the Bun runtime TLS stack.
crypto_password_storage_justification: Decant has no external-user password authentication or password database; its local archive API is unauthenticated and binds to loopback by default. https://github.com/dosu-ai/decant/blob/main/docs/architecture.md
crypto_random_justification: Decant implements no application-level cryptographic key or nonce generation; HTTPS operations use the runtime implementation. https://github.com/dosu-ai/decant/blob/main/src/update.ts
delivery_mitm_justification: Default installation and release delivery use HTTPS, with SHA256SUMS and optional GitHub attestation verification documented for release artifacts. https://github.com/dosu-ai/decant/blob/main/docs/distribution.md
delivery_unsigned_justification: Releases and SHA256SUMS are fetched only over HTTPS or a local file:// mirror. The installer and decant update refuse plain HTTP mirrors (https://github.com/dosu-ai/decant/pull/230), and releases carry Sigstore provenance.
vulnerabilities_fixed_60_days_justificat: There are no open Dependabot alerts or published security advisories, so no medium or higher vulnerability has been publicly known for more than 60 days: https://github.com/dosu-ai/decant/security
vulnerabilities_critical_fixed_justifica: No critical vulnerabilities have been reported. Dependabot security updates are enabled to fix dependency vulnerabilities quickly.
no_leaked_credentials_justification: Repository guidance forbids real credentials and transcripts, fixtures must be synthetic, and the repository secret-scanning API currently reports no open alerts. https://github.com/dosu-ai/decant/blob/main/AGENTS.md
static_analysis_justification: CI applies Biome static analysis on pull requests and main; the documented release gate requires these checks to pass. https://github.com/dosu-ai/decant/blob/main/.github/workflows/ci.yml
static_analysis_common_vulnerabilities_j: CodeQL security-extended queries scan JavaScript/TypeScript and GitHub Actions for security defects. https://github.com/dosu-ai/decant/blob/main/.github/workflows/codeql.yml
static_analysis_fixed_justification: CodeQL findings are triaged as they arrive. The one confirmed medium finding was fixed in https://github.com/dosu-ai/decant/pull/228, and the other two were dismissed as false positives with reasons.
static_analysis_often_justification: CodeQL runs on pull requests and main pushes, with an additional weekly schedule; Biome also runs in CI. https://github.com/dosu-ai/decant/blob/main/.github/workflows/codeql.yml
dynamic_analysis_justification: fast-check varies parser and search inputs and asserts invariants during the automated test suite run by CI. https://github.com/dosu-ai/decant/blob/main/test/parser-properties.test.ts
dynamic_analysis_unsafe_justification: Project application code is TypeScript and JavaScript, with no project-authored memory-unsafe application implementation; native runtime dependencies are upstream software. https://github.com/dosu-ai/decant/blob/main/package.json
dynamic_analysis_enable_assertions_justi: The fast-check tests execute Bun expect assertions for generated inputs, including parser totality and search-query safety. https://github.com/dosu-ai/decant/blob/main/test/parser-properties.test.ts
dynamic_analysis_fixed_justification: Generated-input tests run in CI, but the repository does not establish the remediation history for every confirmed medium-or-higher vulnerability found through dynamic analysis. https://github.com/dosu-ai/decant/blob/main/test/parser-properties.test.ts
